description.p: Flâneur is a fast, open, multi-service video client: your subscriptions and your history on several video platforms, side by side, in one native app.

ul.li: Home, subscriptions and history merged across services
Playback with hardware decoding when the GPU supports the codec
Accounts stay on your computer, in the system keyring

description.p: This is an early development version: service connectors come in upcoming releases.
Flâneur is an independent project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by any of the services it connects to; their names and trademarks belong to their owners.
First development version: the app shell, the video grid and the player.
